items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: Cosmo Matassa? You know Cosmo? Very well, very good friend.

ctx.x: You know what Cosmo told me?
Cosmo Matassa? You know Cosmo? Very well, very good friend.

It's something, it was about living so long, and he said, Gee, if I'd known I was going to live this long, Ted, I would have paid better attention. But he said another thing, he says, another good thing Cosmo said was, he says, we're talking about history, and he said, history? He says, I was too busy making a living. And when you think about it, you know. How about that? That's what he said. He said, look, you know, everybody talks about him doing such great records and recordings and so on. And you forget he…
